issue_128_plan: No first-run disclosure exists today: the window has only the five-step tour (src/main.ts:39-68, localStorage key switchboard.tour) and the About panel switch (src/main.ts:1790-1800, analyticsPanel); the log shows analytics_flush sent right after every owner start, background starts included. Implementing #128 touches: (1) crates/switchboard-runtime/src/analytics.rs: State (around line 160) gains disclosed_at (this app's analytics-state.json, never the shared PassionCode/installation.json); track() (261), started() (363) and tick() (388) return before queueing while disclosed_at is absent; set_enabled() (237) records disclosed_at for either answer and, when the answer is on, reports the held app_installed/app_started after it; Analytics::new() (195-201) must tell an absent state file (fresh install) from an unreadable one (ask again, send nothing, never re-send app_installed); an upgraded state (installed true, no disclosed_at) asks once and is not counted as a new install; status() (229) returns disclosed. (2) crates/switchboard-runtime/src/lib.rs: enable_analytics_with (1561-1576) still builds the client but sends nothing before disclosure; analytics_status (1581) and set_analytics (1588) carry disclosed; monitor.rs:255-257 tick stays silent. (3) src-tauri/src/main.rs:888-896 (analytics_status, set_analytics) pass the new field; a --background start shows nothing and sends nothing until the window opens. (4) src/types.ts:136-147 (analytics() currently typed as LoginItem {available, enabled}: needs its own type with disclosed), src/adapter.ts:89-90, src/demo.ts (demo adapter), src/main.ts: a first-run notice card shown before the tour when available && !disclosed (what is counted, 'nothing has been sent yet', the switch on, Continue), and the About note in analyticsPanel; Russian strings in src/locales/ru.ts. (5) Tests in analytics.rs against the existing synthetic server helper (serve, line 579): nothing reaches the server before the answer, including app_installed and a background start; an upgraded state is not a new install; an unreadable state asks again; plus a ui-logic test for when the notice shows. (6) Docs in the same change: docs/ANALYTICS.md (what is sent and when), docs/ux/scenarios.md SCN-044 and a new first-run notice scenario, docs/brand/strings.md, the backlog row for #128.
